description: hydrographie lagunaire 1868 (Ponts et chaussées) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. digitization of the hydrography of the lagoons of the Palavasian complex, peyrade and gold. The outline of the lagoon and the Rhone Canal in Sète are digitized from the paper maps made by the bridges and carriageways in 1868 (ADH report 7S726). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Lagoon Hydrography 1868 (Bridges and Roads)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include hydrographie, étang, Méditerranée, lagune, languedoc roussillon. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
